Scintal Reef is a miles-long coral reef which sweeps around the southwest perimeter of the Eye, under the Maelstrom. Makrura activity here keeps the naga at bay — the makrura consider this reef their territory and their capital city of Mak'aru is located within.

.]] A scholar is one who studies scholarship — the body of principles and practices used to make their claims about the world as valid and trustworthy as possible, and to make them known to the public. Vectus in the Scholomance led a group of Scourge scholars. The blue dragonflight and the Burning Legion have their own scholars.
__NOTOC__ Scions of Eternity are human, blood elf, and high elf mages aligned with the Blue dragonflight found in the Eye of Eternity. They are a part of phase 2 of the Malygos encounter.

The Scorched Plain is an area east of the Regrowth that once held the Guardians of Hyjal's forward base in Mount Hyjal. The entire town was destroyed by the fiery army led by the Twilight's Hammer. Captain Irontree and Logram, among a few other Irontree Wardens, survived the original attack and now position themselves in the main building defending themselves off from the army that continues the assault. Far east of the scorched town in a clearing is the flamegate to the Crucible of Flame.

Scorched Gully is small gully that has been ravaged by the fearsome malfunctioning Mechachicken on the Lost Isles. The water flows from here to the Dire Strait. There is a nearby bridge, built by the goblins, that crosses the small river leading to the western side of the large island.
Scorched Earth is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Schnottz Scout was a human located and killed within the Chamber of the Stars in Uldum. On him you'll find the Broken Spectacles.

The Schneiders are a family of clothiers and cloth sellers located in Stormwind City. They own and run the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, from which they sell their wares. The family consists of the following members: * * * * *
The Scion of Magic is one of three Ethereum ethereals keeping Azuregos captive at the Axis of Alignment in the Beyond during The Nexus Vault (mage) / The Nexus Vault (priest).
Scintillating Moonlight is a Guardian druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Fortitude of the Cenarion Circle and Fleshknitting traits.
__NOTOC__ Scheming Flames are pandaren spirits who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Schwinderhoof notes are found on a totem pole on a platform at the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain.
Schematic: Omnipotential Core is looted from a Protoform Schematic in the Locus Shift in Zereth Mortis.
Schematic: Red Fireflight is sold by Rabul at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken for .
Scorpid Sting is a ranged ability that reduces the target's chance to hit with melee and ranged attacks by 3%. It cost to train at level 22.

A scourgestone is an item given to all Scourge upon birth or creation. It provides certain benefits to the holder, but more importantly it allows Scourge leaders visibility into the location and movement of all of their units. Scourgestones are weak when separated from their holder, and can easily be crushed into fragments. It is possible to purge a scourgestone and to turn it inert but this attracts the attention of undead for countless miles. With a rare magic that is able to turn the evil of something against itself, it is then possible to purify the inert stone into a Holy Mightstone. During Death Rising, minions of the Scourge were discovered to be carrying a new, darker type of scourge

Scout Bloodfist is an orc quest giver located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, as several bodies of the Orgrimmar Legion were found in the destroyed Silithus, it is unclear if Scout Bloodfist managed to escape or perished as well.

Scourgebane was a trinket that passively increased a paladin's stamina, and provided a 5-minute burst of attack power when dealing with undead and demons. It had a 30-minute cooldown and functioned as a weapon buff. Scourgebane was created by interweaving a Putrid Vine through the fragments of many scourgestones to fortify them. As a former tool of the Scourge, it serves its owner against its will.
__NOTOC__ Scourgebane Draught is a one-use potion that gives you a temporary buff to your attack power against undead. As a quest reward from Tranquillien, it is only available to Horde players.
Scorchshell Pincers are scorpids found in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Scourge of Lordaeron is the name of the Human Campaign in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. King Terenas had sent his son, Prince Arthas, to help his mentor Uther the Lightbringer to confront the Blackrock orcs, who planned to attack Strahnbrad to slaughter the villagers in the name of their demon lords. Weeks later, Arthas, along with Jaina and Captain Falric, went to investigate the plague, where they encountered several undead and the necromancer Kel'Thuzad, who managed to kill him but before telling him about his lord Mal'Ganis, who leads this plague. After witnessing the villagers being turned into undead by the grain. Arthas would go to Stratholme to destroy Mal'Ganis only to discover
These drakes fly around Onyxia's Lair in southern Dustwallow Marsh. While attackable, not every class may be able to reach them from the ground.

__NOTOC__ Scourge Siege Engineers run Scourge Meat Wagons assembled at the Siege Vise in the Eastern Plaguelands. Their company was staging for an attack on the Ghostlands until they were stopped by a Blood Knight intervention. They use a variety of models, but all Scourge Siege Engineers use the same abilities.

The Scourge Gryphon serves as a flight path taxi between Acherus: The Ebon Hold and Death's Breach during the starting instance for Death Knights. They also ferry players from Light's Point back to Death's Breach after annihilating 200 Scarlet Fleet Defenders while on the quest Massacre At Light's Point.
Scourge Strike is an Unholy death knight ability that deals physical and Shadow damage.
Scourgebeak Fleshrippers are undead eagles that can be found flying around the Fleshwerks in Icecrown.
Scourged Earth can be found just southwest of the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra.

The Scout Bats were used by Darkspear Scouts to scout the Echo Isles to determine the defenses that Zalazane had. They were handled by Handler Marnlek. Following the Cataclysm, Marnlek uses Scout Bats as a way of transporting adventurers from Sen'jin Village by flight.

Scout Utvoch is an orc quest giver first met at the Horde outpost of Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale, listening to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain give a speech. He later takes a caravan to join the war effort in Stonetalon Mountains, and due to his high rank is sent onwards to Krom'gar Fortress. He is then given the assignment of helping get supplies from the Deep Reaches, but his team is waylaid by problems. Following the Burning of Teldrassil, he was encountered by the Alliance inside the Blackfathom Deeps.

Scott Smith is a dwarf found on the Summer Terrace at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He's playing a game of Hearthstone with Omar Gonzalez, with Zhen Zhen Wang and Ian Gerdes looking on. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Scout Commander Barus is a night elf quest giver located at Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains. He was sent to deal with The Bomb.
__NOTOC__ Scout Mistress Yvonia is a human quest giver located at the Mirkfallon Post in Stonetalon Mountains. She is planning to sabotage the Bilgewater Cartel in the area.
__NOTOC__ Scorpion-Lord Namkhare is a Neferset tol'vir located at Neferset City in Uldum.

This nameless demon-controlled Scourge base is located in the Hyjal Summit area during the Battle for Mount Hyjal. The waves of Scourge forces that attack the Alliance Base spawn at this area's entrance. The base is made up of buildings and units rather similar to how they were in Warcraft III. There is a ziggurat, two crypts, a plague cauldron, a slaughterhouse, and the stone gazebo structure otherwise only seen in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter and Deatholme. There is even a small Abomination-building workshop. The base is populated with ghouls, necromancers and abominations. Several meat wagons can also be seen. __NOTOC__ Scout Brightspear is a high elf located in Darkstone Isle on the Broken Shore guarding Pustulio the Lesser with Ranger Duskhaft and Ranger Fardawn during Call of the Marksman. Afterward, he is seen patrolling the entrance to the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain, riding a Quel'dorei Steed.

Scout Towers are tall, sturdy structures constructed to guard the borders of many settlements. From these sites, the defenders of Lordaeron can spot enemy troops from high above, making it difficult for the Orcs to launch surprise attacks. Their presence in the wildlands assures the swift deployment of our armies to meet any Orc incursion. These Towers may be outfitted with either deadly bolts that can pierce targets on land, sea and air, or with great cannon that while powerful, cannot attack threats from above.
Scorchwing Felspitters are felbats located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.

Scorpashi Duneclaws are scorpids located in several regions of southwestern Vol'dun, specifically the Arid Basin, the dunes northwest of the Scorched Sands Arena, and Scorpox's ridge near the mountains.
The unnamed coast was a location within the Tirisfal Glades. It was from this place Arthas Menethil sailed to Northrend during his flight from Lordaeron. It was garrisoned by Scourge forces.
Scorching Sands Wristguards are a quest reward from Shattered and Broken.

__NOTOC__ The Scorned Spirit of Water is a water elemental made from five captured Enraged Water Spirits. It is questioned along with the other elementals at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley during Enraged Spirits of Air.

The Scorned Spirit of Fire is an entropic elemental made from eight captured Enraged Fire Spirits captured by the Totem of Spirits. It is questioned along with the other elementals at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley during Enraged Spirits of Air.

The Scorned Spirit of Earth is an earth elemental made from eight captured Enraged Earth Spirits captured by the Totem of Spirits. It is questioned along with the other elementals at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley during Enraged Spirits of Air.

Scourge Deathspeakers are humans located in Zeb'Halak in Grizzly Hills. They are channeling magic into the Seer of Zeb'Halak.

Scorpid Relocators are massive amber scorpions located in the Venomsting Pits in the Assault on Zan'vess. They carry around Sonic Control Towers and must be dealt with first, before the towers canbe destroyed.
__NOTOC__ Scout Ri'tal is a Highmountain tauren located in the Waking Shores.

The Scrap Field is a hill covered with the remains of several destroyed fel reavers. The Burning Legion occupy the scraps, dangerously near the Eco-Dome Midrealm.
__NOTOC__ Scout Zagran is an orc quest giver located at the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley.

Invented by the Alliance as they explored Kalimdor, the scout balloon is a backpack containing a balloon inflated with hot air produced by a tiny phlogiston engine. A small propeller on the pack allows the pilot limited maneuverability, but scout balloons are usually tethered to a tree and used simply for an elevated view of the surrounding territory. Cheap and simple to operate, scout balloons are becoming increasingly popular. It moves at 10 miles per hour and has a crew of 1.
The Scrap Reaver X6000 can be found in Netherstorm. Controlled by the player, as a pet, this fel reaver is required to stop Negatron from destroying the X-52 Nether-Rocket in Area 52.

[http://wow.scribblemaps.com http://wow.scribblemaps.com] WOW Scribblemaps lets you rapidly create custom World of warcraft maps. Features Include: No account needed. Draw all over Azeroth with shapes, lines, and scribbles. View flight paths, herbs, ores, location, and footlocker markers. Rapidly find places of interest through an auto-complete search box. Place over 5000 types of WoW markers and Icons. Create a custom widget for your website or blog. Save and send custom maps to friends.

The Screaming Reaches is the region in northwestern Un'Goro Crater, just west of Mossy Pile. This appropriately named area is filled with screeching pterrordax. In the far northwestern part of this area is another ramp, similar to the one used to enter Un'Goro, that exits into Silithus. This is the only area Yellow Power Crystals can be found. During the Primalists' attack, the area was invaded by elementals. Their presence imbued the beasts of the area.

These scaly denizens of the ocean have often been associated with the coming of prodigious storms, but few have actually seen them rise from the sea and lived to tell the tale.

Sea giants, also called skrogs, are giants created by the titans to help them dredge out the seas and lift the land from the sea floor of Azeroth. The few that remain are particularly aggressive and hostile. They are known to deliberately sink ships and stealing their loot. A sea giant kingdom is located in the island region of Azsuna on the Broken Isles. These giants have allied with Queen Azshara's naga minions. The Felrage Skrogs and fel naga at the Felrage Strand on the Broken Shore serve the Burning Legion. The Sea King was a very powerful sea giant who came to lead the sea giants surrounding the Echo Isles. He found the axe, Killmaim, after it had been thrown into the sea by Dethorin. The sea giant personally made his home outside of Vol'jin's first base camp on the isles and his might went unmatched until Admiral Daelin Proudmoore sent his plans in motion to invade the newly formed orc capital of Orgrimmar. Sent by Warchief Thrall the beastmaster Rexxar and his companions Rokhan and Chen Stormstout traveled to the Echo Isles to seek the aid of the Darkspear tribe for the coming battle with Daelin. Scryer Retainers are blood elves aligned with the Scryers. They can be found in Area 52 in the Netherstorm and in the Scryer's Tier of Shattrath City.

The Sea Reaver's Run is the strait north of Icecrown, between the Northrend and an island called Hrothgar's Landing. Halfway the strait are The Wavecrest and The Firehawk, fending off the Kvaldir Harpooners, Kvaldir Berserkers, and the North Sea Kraken. At the southern end of the run are The Silver Blade and The Crimson Dawn, waiting to strike. Between The Wavecrest and The Firehawk is an unnamed kvaldir raiding vessel manned by Kvaldir Deepcallers, which control the kraken. Scurvy Pirates are creep human units found in Chasing Visions in the Exodus of the Horde campaign of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. They can only be seen with the cheat code "Iseedeadpeople" and with Thrall's Far Sight ability. There are two of them, yet have different stats. One of them has the same stats as a Bandit while the other has the same stats as a Brigand.

During the Fourth War, Derek Proudmoore briefly settled here after returning to his homeland, forming a close relationship with Calia Menethil, as well as renewing his and Calia's personal bonds with Derek's younger sister Jaina Proudmoore. However, Derek, although still considering himself one of the Proudmoores, decided to leave his homeland and Jaina yet again after departing with Calia to Calston Estate to meet Lilian Voss of the Forsaken.

Seal of Fury was a Paladin self-buff spell used to generate more threat from melee attacks. As of the paladin talent review in 1.9, this ability has been replaced with Righteous Fury.

The Seal of Ascension is a ring with several abilities that is obtained through a quest. It is no longer required for access to the upper portion of Blackrock Spire (BRS), but it can be worn to protect you from one of Gyth's special attacks as well as summon the spirit of Vaelastrasz the Red to help you in the fight against Rend Blackhand.

Seal of Command is a paladin ability, available at level 3. At level 24, it is replaced with Seal of Truth. Before it was removed in patch 4.0.1 it was a talent in the Retribution tree, that required 10 talent points invested in the tree to take. Using a Judgment spell while Seal of Command was active dealt Holy damage. Holy damage was also applied on each weapon swing.

:"There are no limits to what you can accomplish when you wield the Light." - Grand Marshal Goldensword Seal of Righteousness is a Protection and Retribution paladin ability, learned at level 42. Using Judgment when Seal of Righteousness is active deals a high amount of Holy damage. A moderate amount of Holy damage is also applied on each weapon swing.

A Seaforium charge is an explosive created and used by an Engineer that will open locked doors, chests, and lockboxes depending on the level of Lockpicking skill required to open the lock. Only Engineers can use a Seaforium charge. Seaforium charges gained the ability to open chests and lockboxes in patch 2.1.0. In general, a rogue's Pick Lock skill is more convenient, because seaforium charges are used up when a lock is opened. However, an Engineer with some seaforium can be useful when there are no rogues around who can open the lock.
Seal of the Damned is a very powerful epic ring for DPS casters.

Seal of Wisdom is a Paladin ability that gives the Paladin a chance to restore 4% of the Paladin's maximum mana upon each melee hit or Judgment. The buff lasts for 30 minutes and cannot be dispelled. It is learned at level 38 for .
Searing Peak is a volcanic peak found in the Redridge Mountains. The Flame Pattern rune is drawn from a ley line which lies deep within the volcano's caldera.
The Seafire Band is a ring that gives a bonus to strength, agility, and stamina.
The Seal of Sylvanas is a ring that gives good bonuses to strength and stamina.
Seal of Wyrnn is a ring. It gives bonuses to strength, agility, stamina, intellect, and spirit. It is great for all round twinks.
Searing Needle is a Level 51 quality Dagger that has a chance on hit to deal extra fire damage, and temporarily increase the target's vulnerability to fire spells.
Seal of the Exorcist is an epic caster ring that boosts stamina, spell power, and resilience.

A variety of seahorse found in Nazjatar called a tidestallion looks different from others, more closely resembling an actual horse from the waist up. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Searing Gorge Quests. The second invasion refers to the Burning Legion's second attempt to destroy the world of Azeroth through full-scale military action. The Sect of the Dragons is one of the faiths of Azeroth. Before the Titans left Azeroth, they invested the five dragon Aspects with tremendous power. The Aspects are Alexstrasza the Life-Binder, Malygos the Spell-Weaver, Neltharion the Earth-Warder (now known as Deathwing), Nozdormu the Timeless and Ysera the Dreamer. The Aspects have many worshipers among the night elves and other isolated groups such as dragonspawn. Domains: Elements, Healing, War. (Priests of Deathwing substitute the Destruction domain for Healing.)

Secrets of the Empire are a semi-rare drop from all bosses in the Throne of Thunder or the eight first bosses in Siege of Orgrimmar in all difficulty levels. The chance for the item to drop is one attempt per eligible boss, per week across all difficulties, and the chance for the item to drop is the same regardless of difficulty mode. Lei Shen and the Sha of Pride have a 100% drop rate. Much like with the Sigil of Power and Sigil of Wisdom back in Patch 5.0, in all difficulty modes, secrets are personal loot, meaning that each member of the raid has an individual chance to loot one copy. Secrets of the Stone is a jewelcrafting research design spell. It allows a jewelcrafter to learn previously unknown gem cuts. The design cut learnt is randomly selected, as opposed to the other specific research spells. The spell has no cooldown. This recipe also produces a Facets of Research which contains 2 random cut MoP rare gems and 2-4 Shattered Gem Fragments.

Secondary stat attunements are specialization-specific passive abilities which increase the amount of a particular secondary stat gained from all sources by 5%. Some also have additional effects. Attunements are intended as a rough guideline to which secondary stat each spec should focus on. However, Spirit for healers and Bonus Armor for tanks are never increased by attunements, meaning these specializations will receive less direct benefits from their attunements.

The Seers are an order of tauren priests who revere the wisdom of the Earthmother as illuminated by the Light of An'she, and exist under the leadership of the Sunwalkers. They were founded by Tahu Sagewind after a series of theological discussions with Aponi Brightmane about the importance of balancing out the night elven focus on moon-worship through reverence of light as part of their worship of the Earth Mother. As such, they rediscovered the use of the Light. The way of the priest is a new one for the tauren, but it draws on the ancient traditions of their seers, and they are not forging a new path so much as rediscovering old ways that we had forgotten. An unnamed Horde gunship took part in the battle for the Seething Shore. The vessel, under the command of High Warlord Volrath, was sent to the small island with a force of champions to recover the newly-formed :Azerite deposits present.
